title: stipa borysthenica var. marchica
intro: Stipa borysthenica var. marchica, commonly known as March's feather grass, is a type of perennial grass native to Eastern Europe. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems, inflammation, and gastrointestinal disorders, due to its health benefits, such as reducing fever and alleviating cough. The therapeutic actions of March's feather grass include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which help to relax muscles, reduce inflammation, and facilitate the removal of mucus from the lungs. The bioactive constituents of March's feather grass include flavonoids, saponins, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
